title: Advanced ML Methods
description: Tackle the hardest ML interview topics: vanishing and exploding gradients in deep networks, stacking ensemble mechanics and boosting failure modes under noisy labels, PCA and dimensionality reduction tradeoffs, transfer learning strategy for small datasets, and L1 vs L2 regularization for correlated features. Scenario-heavy questions that test deep reasoning, not surface recall.
outcomes: You will be able to explain why sigmoid activations cause vanishing gradients and how batch normalization + ReLU solves it, describe how stacking meta-learners can overfit and how out-of-fold predictions prevent this, explain why AdaBoost fails under label noise while random forests are robust, apply partial fine-tuning strategy for small domain datasets using pretrained networks, select between L1 and L2 regularization based on the correlation structure of features, and interpret PCA explained variance to choose the right number of components.
